title: DNP3: Retrieve timestamp with ENC_TIME_MSECS|ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN
description:
The DNP3 timestamp is a little endian 48-bit count of miliseconds
since the Unix epoch, i.e. ENC_TIME_MSECS|ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN.
Use that encoding directly instead of reimplementing it. Get the
returned nstime_t because a string representation is appended to a
parent item in most cases.

DNP3: Retrieve timestamp with ENC_TIME_MSECS|ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN

The DNP3 timestamp is a little endian 48-bit count of miliseconds
since the Unix epoch, i.e. ENC_TIME_MSECS|ENC_LITTLE_ENDIAN.
Use that encoding directly instead of reimplementing it. Get the
returned nstime_t because a string representation is appended to a
parent item in most cases.
